greeting: Hello! I'm the Student Support Assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi there! What can I help you with regarding your studies today?
goodbye: Goodbye! Feel free to come back if you have more questions.
Take care! Good luck with your studies.
thanks: You're welcome! Let me know if there's anything else.
office_hours: Most academic advisors hold office hours Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 4 PM. Please check your professor's syllabus for their specific times.
Office hours are typically listed on your course syllabus or the department website. Generally, the advising office is open 9 AM–4 PM on weekdays.
registration_deadline: Registration deadlines vary by semester — typically two weeks before the term starts. Check the academic calendar on the registrar's website for exact dates.
The add/drop period usually runs during the first week of classes. Visit the registrar's page for this term's exact deadline.
financial_aid: You can apply for financial aid through the FAFSA at studentaid.gov. Your school's financial aid office can help with scholarships and grants too.
For financial aid questions, contact the Financial Aid Office directly — they handle FAFSA, scholarships, and loan counseling.
library_hours: The main library is typically open 8 AM–10 PM on weekdays and 10 AM–6 PM on weekends. Hours may extend during finals week.
Library hours vary by semester — check the library's website for real-time hours, especially around exams.
tech_support: For login or password issues, try the 'Forgot Password' link on the student portal. If that doesn't work, contact IT Support.
Sounds like a tech issue — I'd recommend reaching out to the campus IT Help Desk for direct troubleshooting.
course_selection: Course selection depends on your major requirements — I'd recommend checking your degree audit or speaking with your academic advisor.
Your academic advisor can help map out required courses and electives based on your degree plan.
mental_health_support: Your campus Counseling Center offers free confidential support for students — I'd encourage you to reach out to them directly.
It's completely normal to feel stressed during the semester. Campus counseling services are available and confidential — please consider reaching out.
escalate_human: Of course — I'll flag this for a human advisor to follow up with you. You can also visit the Student Services office directly for immediate help.
